```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(R2jags)
library(coda)
library(patchwork)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")
study_2_path <- file.path(main_path, "study_2")
results_path <- file.path(main_path, "results")
models_path <- file.path(main_path, "models")
prior_models_path <- file.path(main_path, "models/prior_sensitivity_test")
prior_figure_path <- file.path(study_2_path, "figures/prior_sensitivity")

dir.create(prior_figure_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
set.seed(7386)

demographics <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "demographics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
roundwise_clean <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "roundwise_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
source(file.path(main_path, "overall_functions.R"))

```


```{r}
#analytic sample
dem_solo_analytic <- demographics %>%
  filter(
    setup == "SOLO",
    !excluded,
    !participant.code %in% c("l6gxo7po", "n0ndmyka")) # Two participants excluded due to technical errors

solo_ids <- dem_solo_analytic %>%
  distinct(id)

solo_rounds <- roundwise_clean %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "SOLO") %>%
  semi_join(solo_ids, by = "id")
```

```{r}
# Derive duration and sound-condition variables
solo_rounds <- solo_rounds %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    completed = as.integer(completed),
    secs = as.numeric(secs),
    log_secs = log(secs + 1),
    any_sound = as.integer(replace_na(any_stimulus, FALSE)),
    sound1_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound1_stimulus, "")),
    sound2_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound2_stimulus, "")),
    sound3_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound3_stimulus, "")),
    any_cry = as.integer(
      str_detect(sound1_lower, "cry|cries") |
        str_detect(sound2_lower, "cry|cries") |
        str_detect(sound3_lower, "cry|cries")),
    any_alarm = as.integer(
      str_detect(sound1_lower, "alarm") |
        str_detect(sound2_lower, "alarm") |
        str_detect(sound3_lower, "alarm")),
    round_sound_type = case_when(
      any_sound == 0 ~ "none",
      any_cry == 1 & any_alarm == 0 ~ "cry_only",
      any_cry == 0 & any_alarm == 1 ~ "alarm_only",
      any_cry == 1 & any_alarm == 1 ~ "mixed_cry_alarm"),
    round_sound_type = factor(
      round_sound_type,
      levels = c(
        "none",
        "alarm_only",
        "cry_only",
        "mixed_cry_alarm"))) %>%
  filter(round_sound_type != "mixed_cry_alarm") %>%
  droplevels()
```


```{r}
duration_df <- solo_rounds %>%
  filter(
    completed == 1,
    round_sound_type %in% c("none", "alarm_only", "cry_only"),
    !is.na(log_secs),
    !is.na(gender),
    !is.na(participant.code)) %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(
    gender = relevel(gender, ref = "Female"),
    round_sound_type = relevel(
      round_sound_type,
      ref = "none"))

duration_model_df <- duration_df %>%
  mutate(
    gender_num = if_else(gender == "Male", 1L, 0L),
    sound_num = case_when(
      round_sound_type == "none" ~ 1L,
      round_sound_type == "alarm_only" ~ 2L,
      round_sound_type == "cry_only" ~ 3L),
    participant_id = as.integer(factor(participant.code)))
```

```{r}
data_list_duration <- list(
  N = nrow(duration_model_df),
  J = n_distinct(duration_model_df$participant_id),
  y = as.numeric(duration_model_df$log_secs),
  gender = as.integer(duration_model_df$gender_num),
  sound = as.integer(duration_model_df$sound_num),
  participant = as.integer(duration_model_df$participant_id))

params_duration <- c(
  # Basic coefficients
  "b0",
  "b_gender",
  "b_sound",
  "b_sound_gender",

  # Variance components
  "sigma_participant",
  "sigma",

  # Condition means
  "mean_none_female",
  "mean_alarm_female",
  "mean_cry_female",
  "mean_none_male",
  "mean_alarm_male",
  "mean_cry_male",

  # Within-gender contrasts
  "alarm_vs_none_female",
  "cry_vs_none_female",
  "alarm_vs_cry_female",
  "alarm_vs_none_male",
  "cry_vs_none_male",
  "alarm_vs_cry_male",

  # Gender differences in sound contrasts
  "gender_diff_alarm",
  "gender_diff_cry",
  "gender_diff_alarm_vs_cry",

  # Prior-reference draws
  "b_gender_prior",
  "b_sound_prior",
  "b_sound_gender_prior",

  # Prior-reference contrasts
  "alarm_vs_none_female_prior",
  "cry_vs_none_female_prior",
  "alarm_vs_cry_female_prior",
  "alarm_vs_none_male_prior",
  "cry_vs_none_male_prior",
  "alarm_vs_cry_male_prior",
  "gender_diff_alarm_prior",
  "gender_diff_cry_prior",
  "gender_diff_alarm_vs_cry_prior",
  
  # Posterior predictive check
  "fit_obs",
  "fit_rep",
  "ppc_greater")
```

```{r}
samples_primary <- readRDS(file.path(results_path, "s2_jags_duration_sound_gender.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Narrow prior sensitivity model 
samples_path_narrow <- file.path(results_path, "s2_prior_sens_sound_effect_narrow.rds")

if (file.exists(samples_path_narrow)) {

  samples_narrow <-
    readRDS(samples_path_narrow)

} else {

  samples_narrow <- jags.parallel(
    data = data_list_duration,
    inits = NULL,
    parameters.to.save = params_duration,
    model.file = file.path(
      prior_models_path,
      "s2_sound_effect_narrow.bugs"),
    n.chains = 12,
    n.iter = 25000,
    n.burnin = 5000,
    n.thin = 1)

  saveRDS(
    samples_narrow,
    samples_path_narrow)
}
```

```{r}
# Broad prior sensitivity model 
samples_path_broad <- file.path(results_path, "s2_prior_sens_sound_effect_broad.rds")

if (file.exists(samples_path_broad)) {

  samples_broad <-
    readRDS(samples_path_broad)

} else {

  samples_broad <- jags.parallel(
    data = data_list_duration,
    inits = NULL,
    parameters.to.save = params_duration,
    model.file = file.path(
      prior_models_path,
      "s2_sound_effect_broad.bugs"),
    n.chains = 12,
    n.iter = 25000,
    n.burnin = 5000,
    n.thin = 1)

  saveRDS(
    samples_broad,
    samples_path_broad)
}
```

### convergence check
```{r}
extract_sensitivity_convergence <- function(samples, prior_label) {

  samples$BUGSoutput$summary %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("parameter") %>%
    filter(
      parameter %in% c(
        "b_gender",
        "b_sound[2]",
        "b_sound[3]",
        "b_sound_gender[2]",
        "b_sound_gender[3]",
        "gender_diff_alarm",
        "gender_diff_cry",
        "gender_diff_alarm_vs_cry",
        "sigma_participant",
        "sigma")) %>%
    mutate(prior = prior_label)
}

sensitivity_convergence <- bind_rows(
  extract_sensitivity_convergence(
    samples_narrow,
    "N(0, 0.25²)"),
  extract_sensitivity_convergence(
    samples_primary,
    "N(0, 0.50²)"),
  extract_sensitivity_convergence(
    samples_broad,
    "N(0, 1.00²)"))

sensitivity_convergence %>%
  group_by(prior) %>%
  summarise(
    max_Rhat = max(Rhat),
    min_ESS = min(n.eff),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(max_Rhat = sprintf("%.4f", max_Rhat))
```

```{r}
sensitivity_parameters <- c(
  "b_gender",
  "b_sound[2]",
  "b_sound[3]",
  "b_sound_gender[2]",
  "b_sound_gender[3]",
  "gender_diff_alarm",
  "gender_diff_cry",
  "gender_diff_alarm_vs_cry")

prior_sensitivity_results <- bind_rows(

  samples_narrow$BUGSoutput$summary %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("parameter") %>%
    filter(parameter %in% sensitivity_parameters) %>%
    transmute(
      parameter,
      prior = "N(0, 0.25²)",
      mean,
      lower = `2.5%`,
      upper = `97.5%`),

  samples_primary$BUGSoutput$summary %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("parameter") %>%
    filter(parameter %in% sensitivity_parameters) %>%
    transmute(
      parameter,
      prior = "N(0, 0.50²)",
      mean,
      lower = `2.5%`,
      upper = `97.5%`),

  samples_broad$BUGSoutput$summary %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("parameter") %>%
    filter(parameter %in% sensitivity_parameters) %>%
    transmute(
      parameter,
      prior = "N(0, 1.00²)",
      mean,
      lower = `2.5%`,
      upper = `97.5%`)) %>%
  mutate(
    effect = recode(
      parameter,
      "b_gender" = "Male versus female",
      "b_sound[2]" = "Alarm versus no sound",
      "b_sound[3]" = "Infant cry versus no sound",
      "b_sound_gender[2]" = "Alarm × male",
      "b_sound_gender[3]" = "Infant cry × male",
      "gender_diff_alarm" =
        "Female-male difference: alarm versus no sound",
      "gender_diff_cry" =
        "Female-male difference: infant cry versus no sound",
      "gender_diff_alarm_vs_cry" =
        "Female-male difference: alarm versus infant cry"),
    prior = factor(
      prior,
      levels = c(
        "N(0, 0.25²)",
        "N(0, 0.50²)",
        "N(0, 1.00²)"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    effect,
    prior,
    mean,
    lower,
    upper)

prior_sensitivity_results
```


```{r}
p_prior_sensitivity <- prior_sensitivity_results %>%
  filter(
    effect %in% c(
      "Female-male difference: alarm versus no sound",
      "Female-male difference: infant cry versus no sound",
      "Female-male difference: alarm versus infant cry")) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = mean,
      y = prior)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = lower,
      xmax = upper),
    width = 0.15,
    orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(
    size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ effect,
    scales = "free_x",
    ncol = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Female-male difference in sound effect",
    y = "Fixed-effect prior")

plot_png_path <- file.path(
  prior_figure_path,
  "s2_prior_sensitivity_prior_posterior_gender_diff.png")

show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_prior_sensitivity,
  width = 11,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300)
```

draws_narrow <- as.matrix(as.mcmc(samples_narrow))

prior_post_sensitivity_df <- bind_rows(

  # Alarm gender difference
  tibble(
    value = draws_narrow[, "gender_diff_alarm"],
    source = "Posterior",
